description: A Perl script for downloading files with support for multiple mirrors, checksum verification, and local cache handling, used in the context of OpenWrt/LEDE project.

methods.name: localmirrors
methods.description: Reads local mirror URLs from a file and environment variables.

methods.name: which
methods.description: Checks if a program exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: hash_cmd
methods.description: Determines the hash command (md5 or sha256) based on the length of the provided hash.

methods.name: download_cmd
methods.description: Selects between curl and wget for downloading based on availability.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a file from a mirror, verifies hash, and handles local file copying or remote fetching.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes temporary download and hash files.
